title: Pushforward along a closed immersion of the products with the powers of an extended ideal
statement: Let $i:Z\to X$ be a closed immersion of schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-closed-immersion] with ideal sheaf $\mathcal J$ [def-sbc-closed-immersion-ideal-sheaf], let $\mathcal I\subseteq\mathcal O_X$ be a quasi-coherent sheaf of ideals, and let $\mathcal I\mathcal O_Z\subseteq\mathcal O_Z$ be the image of $i^*\mathcal I\to i^*\mathcal O_X\to\mathcal O_Z$ [def-nagata-extended-ideal, def-pc-module-pullback]. Products $\mathcal K\mathcal F$ of a quasi-coherent ideal and a module, the powers $\mathcal K^n$ and the quotients $\mathcal F/\mathcal K\mathcal F$ are as in [def-weil-pbc-coherent-formal-module] (0). (1) $\mathcal I\mathcal O_Z$ is a quasi-coherent sheaf of ideals of $\mathcal O_Z$, and for every affine open $U=\operatorname{Spec}R\subseteq X$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum], with $i^{-1}(U)=\operatorname{Spec}(R/\mathcal J(U))$, one has $(\mathcal I\mathcal O_Z)(i^{-1}U)=\mathcal I(U)\cdot(R/\mathcal J(U))$, the image of $\mathcal I(U)$. (2) For every quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_Z$-module $\mathcal G$ [pqf-def-coherent] and every $n\ge1$, $i_*\big((\mathcal I\mathcal O_Z)^n\mathcal G\big)=\mathcal I^n\,(i_*\mathcal G)$ as sub-$\mathcal O_X$-modules of $i_*\mathcal G$. (3) Consequently, for the quotient map $q:\mathcal G\to\mathcal G/(\mathcal I\mathcal O_Z)^n\mathcal G$, the map $i_*q$ induces an isomorphism $i_*\mathcal G/\mathcal I^n(i_*\mathcal G)\to i_*\big(\mathcal G/(\mathcal I\mathcal O_Z)^n\mathcal G\big)$, natural in $\mathcal G$ and compatible, for $m\ge n$, with the quotient maps from level $m$ to level $n$.

proof.text: Equal image subobjects have isomorphic image objects commuting with their inclusions (Subobject.isoOfMkEqMk). Transport their cokernels by cokernel.mapIso, and compose with cokernelImageι at both ends. Closed pushforward preserves the upstairs cokernel, so compose with the inverse of PreservesCokernel.iso. The projection identity follows from the cokernel desc equations. Choose this uniquely determined isomorphism at each module and level; no arbitrary geometric data is chosen.

proof.text: Precompose each naturality equality with the downstairs cokernel projection and cancel its epimorphism. The defining equation for formalModuleQuotientMap, the projection identity for the chosen isomorphisms, and functoriality turn both composites into pushforward of u followed by the upstairs quotient projection. For m >= n use the same argument with the level-m projection and u = identity. The two composites both become the pushforward of the level-n projection.

lean.statement: theorem closedImmersion_pushforward_idealPowers {X Z : Scheme.{u}} (i : Z ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion i] (I : X.IdealSheafData) : (I.comap i).toModules.IsQuasicoherent ∧ (∀ U : X.affineOpens, ∃ (V : Z.affineOpens) (hV : V.1 = i ⁻¹ᵁ U.1), (I.comap i).ideal V = (I.ideal U).map (i.appLE U.1 V.1 (by simp [hV])).hom) ∧ (∀ (G : Z.Modules) [G.IsQuasicoherent] (n : ℕ), 1 ≤ n → Subobject.mk (image.ι ((Modules.pushforward i).map (idealModuleProductι (idealSheafPower (I.comap i).toModulesι n).2 G))) = Subobject.mk (image.ι (idealModuleProductι (idealSheafPower I.toModulesι n).2 ((Modules.pushforward i).obj G)))) ∧ ∃ ρ : (∀ (G : Z.Modules) [G.IsQuasicoherent] (n : ℕ), 1 ≤ n → (formalModuleQuotient I n ((Modules.pushforward i).obj G) ≅ (Modules.pushforward i).obj (formalModuleQuotient (I.comap i) n G))), (∀ (G : Z.Modules) [G.IsQuasicoherent] (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n), formalModuleQuotientπ I n ((Modules.pushforward i).obj G) ≫ (ρ G n hn).hom = (Modules.pushforward i).map (formalModuleQuotientπ (I.comap i) n G)) ∧ (∀ (G H : Z.Modules) [G.IsQuasicoherent] [H.IsQuasicoherent] (u : G ⟶ H) (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n), formalModuleQuotientMap I ((Modules.pushforward i).map u) (Nat.le_refl n) ≫ (ρ H n hn).hom = (ρ G n hn).hom ≫ (Modules.pushforward i).map (formalModuleQuotientMap (I.comap i) u (Nat.le_refl n))) ∧ (∀ (G : Z.Modules) [G.IsQuasicoherent] (m n : ℕ) (h : n ≤ m) (hn : 1 ≤ n), formalModuleQuotientMap I (𝟙 ((Modules.pushforward i).obj G)) h ≫ (ρ G n hn).hom = (ρ G m (le_trans hn h)).hom ≫ (Modules.pushforward i).map (formalModuleQuotientMap (I.comap i) (𝟙 G) h))
